content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BMC Garden Superintendent Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BMC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the BMC Garden Superintendent Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation (BMC) for filling up vacant positions under advertisement number /BMC/202627/18 through the official portal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced for the Garden Superintendent post?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Garden Superintendent post under Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation recruitment notification for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E. (Agriculture/Horticulture) or B.Sc. (Agriculture/Horticulture) from a recognized University/Institution or equivalent with 3 years experience to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The candidate's age should be between 18 and 35 years. Category-based age relaxations are applicable as per government rules for reserved and female candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Garden Superintendent role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed under the Pay Matrix Level-9 with a salary scale ranging from ₹53100 to ₹167800 per month.

faq.question: Q6. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 05-10-2026 and concludes on 20-10-2026. Candidates must submit their applications before the final deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for unreserved and reserved categories?
faq.answer: Unreserved (General) candidates need to pay Rs. 1000 plus postal charges, while reserved category applicants pay Rs. 500 plus postal charges through designated channels.

faq.question: Q8. Through which website can candidates submit their online application?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their online applications through the official OJAS Gujarat portal at http://ojas.gujarat.gov.in before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for this BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Exam followed by an Oral/Practical Test to evaluate the candidates' knowledge, capability, and suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can find the direct link to download the official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article or via the official website.
